rationale: McpOAuthProvider is the Go struct McpOAuthProvider built by NewMcpOAuthProvider(McpOAuthProviderOptions); the constructor returns an error where upstream throws on a bad serverUrl.
async: An awaited Promise is a blocking Go call that returns the value or error; a rejection (a failed load, a failed save, or the missing-verifier Error) is the returned error; undefined is nil or the empty value. The upstream write chain (this.writes) is Go's mutex plus the sticky write error; no detached goroutine.

clientInformation.rationale: McpOAuthProvider.clientInformation is the Go method McpOAuthProvider.ClientInformation; a Promise is the returned error.

clientMetadata.rationale: The readonly property clientMetadata is the method ClientMetadata(); the defaults for redirect_uris, grant_types, response_types and token_endpoint_auth_method are applied in NewMcpOAuthProvider.

clientMetadataDocument.rationale: The optional callback property is the method ClientMetadataDocument(metadata) (nil callback yields nil), which the flow reaches through the ClientMetadataDocumentProvider interface.

codeVerifier.rationale: McpOAuthProvider.codeVerifier is the Go method McpOAuthProvider.CodeVerifier; a Promise is the returned error.

discoveryState.rationale: McpOAuthProvider.discoveryState is the Go method McpOAuthProvider.DiscoveryState; a Promise is the returned error.

invalidateCredentials.rationale: invalidateCredentials(kind) is InvalidateCredentials(ctx, kind) with the kind as a string ("all", "client", "tokens", "verifier", "discovery").

redirectToAuthorization.rationale: redirectToAuthorization(url) is RedirectToAuthorization(ctx, *url.URL), which calls the configured OnRedirect hook.

redirectUrl.rationale: The readonly property redirectUrl is the method RedirectURL().

saveClientInformation.rationale: McpOAuthProvider.saveClientInformation is the Go method McpOAuthProvider.SaveClientInformation; a Promise is the returned error.

saveCodeVerifier.rationale: McpOAuthProvider.saveCodeVerifier is the Go method McpOAuthProvider.SaveCodeVerifier; a Promise is the returned error.

saveDiscoveryState.rationale: McpOAuthProvider.saveDiscoveryState is the Go method McpOAuthProvider.SaveDiscoveryState; a Promise is the returned error.

saveTokens.rationale: McpOAuthProvider.saveTokens is the Go method McpOAuthProvider.SaveTokens; a Promise is the returned error.

state.rationale: McpOAuthProvider.state is the Go method McpOAuthProvider.State; a Promise is the returned error.

tokens.rationale: McpOAuthProvider.tokens is the Go method McpOAuthProvider.Tokens; a Promise is the returned error.
